Scalar styles and empty collections. The title needs quoting because it contains a colon followed
by a space, and it is not ASCII; `note` is a block scalar; `aliases` and `empty_map` are an empty
sequence and an empty mapping, which a writer that tests emptiness before emitting would silently
drop. None of `note`, `aliases`, or `empty_map` are keys this version interprets.

The title is also the reason `slugify` drops non-ASCII rather than transliterating: this note's
slug would be a judgement call, and the slug is decoration.
